title: Difference-Making without Making a Difference
abstract: arXiv:2606.24832v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Over a series of seven papers, Andreas & G\"unther have introduced seven definitions of actual causation and have classified them as belonging to three different, competing, types of accounts: factual difference-making, counterfactual difference-making, and regularity-based. I show that their most recent -- factual difference-making -- definition instantiates all three types, thereby proving that these are distinctions without a difference. I further compare their novel account to the other six accounts on several crucial examples, revealing that this undermines all seven of their accounts.

translated_title: 制造差异却未产生差异
translated_abstract: 在一系列七篇论文中，Andreas与Günther提出了七种事实因果的定义，并将它们归类为三种不同的、相互竞争的理论类型：事实性差异制造、反事实差异制造以及基于规律性的理论。本文证明了他们最新提出的——事实性差异制造——定义同时体现了所有这三种类型，从而证明这些区分实际上是毫无实质差别的。此外，作者还在若干关键例子上将其新理论与其余六种理论进行了比较，揭示出这一比较动摇了他们全部七种理论。
tldr: 本文证明Andreas与Günther最新提出的“事实性差异制造”因果定义同时体现了其区分的三种竞争性理论类型，表明这些区分毫无实质差别，并通过关键例子的比较动摇了他们全部七种事实因果定义。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that Andreas & Günther's latest "factual difference-making" definition of actual causation instantiates all three of their competing account types—proving these distinctions are without a difference—and that comparison on crucial examples undermines all seven of their definitions.
